questions.question: Not only _____ renewable energy reduce carbon emissions, but it also creates new employment opportunities.
questions.explanation_cn: Not only 位于句首时，需要部分倒装：Not only + 助动词 + 主语 + 动词。
questions.explanation_en: When 'Not only' begins a sentence, inversion is required.

questions.question: Only after the data had been analysed _____ the researchers recognise the significance of the findings.
questions.explanation_cn: Only + 状语位于句首时，主句必须部分倒装。
questions.explanation_en: When 'Only + adverbial' begins a sentence, the main clause requires inversion.

questions.question: Rarely _____ such a significant improvement in air quality within such a short period.
questions.explanation_cn: Rarely 位于句首，需要部分倒装。
questions.explanation_en: 'Rarely' at the beginning of a sentence requires inversion.

questions.question: Little _____ that the discovery would completely transform modern medicine.
questions.explanation_cn: Little 位于句首表示'几乎不知道'，需要倒装。
questions.explanation_en: 'Little' at the beginning requires inversion to emphasize negation.

questions.question: Under no circumstances _____ confidential research data be shared without permission.
questions.explanation_cn: Under no circumstances 位于句首时，需要部分倒装，是 IELTS Academic 高频表达。
questions.explanation_en: 'Under no circumstances' requires inversion in formal English.

questions.question: Only when governments, businesses and individuals work together _____ meaningful progress be achieved.
questions.explanation_cn: Only when... 位于句首时，主句需要倒装，这是 IELTS 大作文非常常见的高级句型。
questions.explanation_en: When 'Only when...' begins a sentence, the main clause requires inversion.

questions.question: Hardly _____ the experiment begun when the equipment malfunctioned.
questions.explanation_cn: 固定结构：Hardly had + 主语 + 过去分词 + when...，表示'刚……就……'。
questions.explanation_en: 'Hardly...when...' requires inversion with the past perfect.

questions.question: Not until the final report was published _____ the significance of the findings.
questions.explanation_cn: Not until 位于句首时，主句需要部分倒装。
questions.explanation_en: 'Not until' at the beginning of a sentence requires inversion in the main clause.

questions.question: So convincing _____ the evidence that the committee approved the proposal immediately.
questions.explanation_cn: So + 形容词 + be + 主语 + that... 是正式英语中的倒装结构。
questions.explanation_en: 'So + adjective + be + subject + that...' is an inverted structure used in formal writing.

questions.question: Such _____ that several universities adopted it as a teaching model.
questions.explanation_cn: 固定倒装结构：Such + be + 名词 + that...。
questions.explanation_en: 'Such + be + noun + that...' is a formal inverted structure.

questions.question: Which of the following sentences are grammatically correct?

options.text: Only after completing the experiment did the researchers publish their findings.
Rarely have scientists encountered such a complex problem.
Not only the study improved public awareness, but it also influenced government policy.
Under no circumstances should confidential information be disclosed.

questions.explanation_cn: A 正确：Only after 位于句首需要倒装。B 正确：Rarely 位于句首需要倒装。C 错误：Not only 位于句首时应为 Not only did the study improve...。D 正确：Under no circumstances 位于句首需要倒装，是正式英语高频表达。
questions.explanation_en: A correctly uses inversion after 'Only after'. B correctly inverts after 'Rarely'. C is incorrect because 'Not only' at the beginning requires inversion ('did the study improve'). D correctly uses inversion after 'Under no circumstances'.
